scope: Independent requested-byte/count backing admission for IOMMU domain cells, persistent requester/stream fences and VT-d context metadata, through existing complete grant, unit and detached owners.
artifact_note: Runtime sources were frozen before all campaigns. Every manifest tracked-diff identity equals the final runtime patch; documentation/evidence edits followed manifest preparation. New source identities are included explicitly.

dimensions: actual requested retirement-node layout bytes including charge and inline payload storage
policy.decision: Total count is four times the existing 65536 unified-capability planning ceiling, with a quarter trusted reserve. Domain cells, persistent fences, context metadata and candidates share the headroom. Actual requester-only count pressure requests 9/12 MiB ordinary/total; the independent 18/24 MiB byte ceilings also permit layout growth. Existing resource and hardware-ID limits are unchanged; no RAM is preallocated.
policy.cost: 16 extra bytes per node, a captured backing-class flag in existing preparation owners, short admission/refund operations and the existing MapFailed rejection. No extra holder allocation, runtime registry or cleanup family.
policy.classification: GrantAdmission retains its generation-captured backing class; PreparedDmaDomain transfers it into DmaCreation before backend entry, separately from resource/waiter grants. Every Nodes candidate captures that original value. No later ASID/role/requester lookup chooses reserve; raw fixtures explicitly select ordinary.
policy.publication: All required candidates precede reset, next-ID mutation, domain backing and descriptor publication. Partial rejection stays with the existing complete grant for post-guard explicit cancellation. Publication only relinks prepared nodes.
policy.release: Domain cells stay charged through extracted payloads, hardware maintenance, table release and data unpins. Post-backend detachment/deallocation precedes refund. Zero requester fences and VT-d context metadata remain unit-owned and charged; later trusted reuse cannot reclassify their original ordinary admission. Units currently have no teardown refund path.
policy.exclusions: Mapping/walker metadata, table-ledger vectors, nested allocations, allocator bookkeeping, aggregate principal/general-heap usage and common live administration remain separate.

host_validation.full_host_suite: Not repeated for this kernel-only change. Changed policy and shared retirement collection run directly; all new family and complete-backend-owner controls run in the three native guests.

controls: Real empty requester-layout nodes fill ordinary 196608 and total 262144 count ceilings. Sixty-four heap-held denial rounds per class exercise every applicable layout: two layouts on ARM and four on x86 (256/512 direct constructor denials respectively).

Complete grant preparation uses real ordinary/trusted roots and their actual captured backing class. Ordinary rejects at ordinary exhaustion, trusted progresses, both reject at total exhaustion. Returning one/two/three slots checks partial metadata rollback and exact recovery without any physical domain payload.

Real empty active-backend domain-layout nodes fill actual ordinary/total byte ceilings with count headroom. A trusted allocation progresses at ordinary byte exhaustion; 64 ordinary and 64 trusted heap-held byte denials and exact backing recovery pass. These allocate full production-layout storage, without creating hardware tables or domain payloads.
Each applicable layout injects 64 node-allocator rejections with exact recovery: 128 on ARM and 256 on x86. Requested native sizes are recorded inline per campaign.

Existing metadata publication and domain-cell detachment controls add the actual budget guard under their existing heap hold. A trusted replacement reuses the original ordinary zero fence at the same value address; original fence/context classification and charges survive until explicit fixture release.

The existing complete-grant abandonment owner retains the same original root, authority, device nodes and backend candidates under its prior guards plus both backing-pool guards. No additional deliberate-retention owner is introduced; complete fallback remains inert.

The real NVMe grant fixture independently saturates ordinary count admission using a test counter reservation, then requires 32 MapFailed rejections before reset/next-ID/table publication. Exact requester/registry snapshots, table charges, authority usage and disabled PCI configuration remain unchanged. This adapter control is counter-only; actual backing pressure is covered by separate controls above.

Existing per-stage node rejection, private/registered rollback, reset/reassignment, map/unmap and acknowledged domain destruction execute in the same suite. Shared retirement host controls establish deallocation-before-refund and inert detached-node fallback.
qualification_limits: Serialized kernel fixtures, not sustained hostile concurrent EL0 fairness or forced native general heap OOM. Allocation errors are injected. Real backing pressure uses empty production-layout nodes; no physical domain/table obligation is fabricated.

The real NVMe quota control uses counter saturation and retains existing reset contracts; no new hardware timeout or outstanding device I/O is injected. Published unit fences/context nodes have no current unit-teardown refund path.
No new resource grant, physical completion proof, lease kind, replay/retry owner, cleanup registry or owner family. Existing C14/C15 and wider caller/IRQ/latency G1/G4 boundaries remain.

Per-domain mapping/walker and table-ledger backing, other registry/control storage, allocator bookkeeping, aggregate signed-principal/general-heap accounting and common live usage reporting remain open. SEC-07 remains partial.
